verdict.rationale: The quickstart docs state that official client libraries are available in Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Go, and Java, which covers all four languages in the story. A community comment adds a Python embedded-package mode. This rests on a single installation-level mention, with no deeper per-SDK documentation in the pack. Missing for 10: in-depth per-language SDK documentation (feature parity, versioning, API references) and independent hands-on corroboration of the TypeScript, Go, and Java clients.
